title: ID0380429-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / R1 170001421] - VW E-Up charging won't start
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: VW e-Up not charging
Root cause:
Possible EV issue
Solution:
Close ticket, customer tested another VW and it was working
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
Location: Kuusalu.
User driving with VW E-Up, complained that the session never started even if the charger is running with 5.0.19 FW version.
In somereasong connection drops from P02 -→ P00. DO we have compatibility issue with E-Up? EVMAC for this car is static 00.7d.fa.01.21.10

Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is

Problem Description
: VW e-UP cannot charge
Troubleshooting

As you can see, in the logs we see a insulation drop when the EV is connected. As such it will never go to Isolation Monitor.
I will see what is possible to do here. In the meantime I would suggest to ask if the customer can update their EVs, we had a similar issue with Jaguar iPace which was solved by updating the FW.
If the FW is already updated then we must see how to reach out to Volkswagen to see if the error is possible to resolve.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0380429
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0380429-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / R1 170001421] - VW E-Up charging won't start CRM:00315001811
additional_info.body:
Hi,
Insulation pre-alarm limit is 500kOhm which is much lower than 1629 or 1644kOhm?
Markus

additional_info.subject: ID0380429-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / R1 170001421] - VW E-Up charging won't start CRM:00315001816
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
Sorry for the wrong information. I mistook with one less number and thought it was less than 200kOhm.
From our side, I don't see any problem on why the session is not starting. There are no EcoG logs from this date so I cannot confirm.
I don't see a charger/plug related problems since we performed 9 sessions properly since last 2 weeks:
Is it possible to schedule a session together with this specific EV so that we can collect EcoG logs? I believe that this might be an EV issue but it's always hard to prove without the right evidence. In our defense, we can only say that there are some charging sessions without problem and only this one had.
I will wait for your feedback.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0380429-DC/Si-D/EE- [MP / R1 170001421] - VW E-Up charging won't start CRM:00315001816
additional_info.body:
Hi Markus,
Just a quick feedback.
We cannot rent cars for testing, unless you can align with the customer we are stuck here. From the general sessions, the outlet and charger seems to be working.
My recommendation is to wait for v5.0.21 and try again to charge. There shouldn't be a big difference but it might work.
If you are not able to schedule it, then I believe we should close the ticket since we are not able to progress
Please let me know your thoughts.
Best regards,
Francisco
